products.name: KIS Legends Edition
products.description:
The entry bat in the KIS range: Kashmir willow shaped for leather-ball cricket, ready for a first season of hard practice. Light enough for a young batter stepping up from tennis-ball games.

Comes in Size 6 and Harrow as well as full size, so a growing player can be fitted properly rather than handed something to grow into. Made in Anantnag by Khan International Sports, pressing willow in Kashmir since 1994.

Best for: a first leather-ball bat, junior and school cricket, net practice.

products.name: KIS Classic — Kashmir Willow
products.description:
The all-round club bat. Grade A++ Kashmir willow with a traditional profile and a mid blade sweet spot that suits every format.

A mid sweet spot is the safe choice when you play both red and white ball — high enough to defend the rising delivery, low enough to drive. If you are buying one bat to do everything, this is the one in the range that does not force a compromise.

Best for: club and league cricket, players who bat across formats.

products.name: KIS AM Unstoppable
products.description:
KIS's signature Unstoppable profile — full-bodied Kashmir willow with a pronounced bow and generous edges for players who back themselves through the line.

The bow brings more of the blade behind the ball at contact, and the edges keep mass where a mis-hit usually finds you. It is a bat with a point of view: it rewards committing to the shot rather than feeling for it.

Best for: aggressive top-order batting, white-ball cricket, players who hit straight and hard.

products.name: KIS Boom Boom Edition
products.description:
Grade A++ Kashmir willow with a low sweet spot and heavy edges, built for hitting through the line in white-ball cricket.

A low sweet spot puts the middle where a full ball arrives, which is what makes this a hitter's bat — yorker-length deliveries and slog-sweeps come off it cleanly. Add heavy edges and the margin down the ground is genuinely forgiving.

Best for: T20 and limited-overs, middle-order power hitting, finishing an innings.

products.name: KIS Game Changer — Kashmir Willow
products.description:
Grade A++ Kashmir willow, thick edges and a big spine, pressed for power without losing pickup. The step up from the Classic for a regular league batter.

The spine is where a bat stores its power and the edges are where it forgives you; this profile is shaped to have both without turning into a plank. Pick it up next to the Classic and the difference in presence is immediate — the difference in weight is not.

Best for: a second season and beyond, competitive league cricket, batters who have outgrown their first bat.

products.name: KIS Bazuka Edition
products.description:
The thick-edge Bazuka profile in Kashmir willow — a big, square-shouldered blade for batters who want maximum mass behind the ball.

This is the largest profile KIS press in Kashmir willow. Square shoulders carry the width higher up the blade than a traditional shape, so there is real timber behind a shot played square of the wicket, not just down the ground.

Best for: strong, physical batters who want the biggest blade in the range. Full size only — feel the pickup before you commit.

products.name: KIS M&H 7000
products.description:
Grade A++ Kashmir willow from KIS's premium press, hand-finished and knocked in ready. A serious club bat at a Kashmir-willow price.

Knocked in ready matters more than it sounds: a new bat needs hours of careful work before it can safely face a hard ball, and this one arrives with that already done properly. Hand-finishing is the difference between a bat that is pressed and a bat that is finished by someone who plays.

Best for: players who want premium feel without moving to English willow, and anyone who would rather bat than knock in.

products.name: KIS Master Pro
products.description:
Top-grade Kashmir willow, hand-picked cleft and a players' profile. The best bat KIS make before the English willow range starts.

Hand-picked means someone stood in the workshop and chose this cleft over the ones beside it — for grain, for weight, for how it rang. That selection is most of what separates a top-grade bat from a good one, and it is why no two are quite identical.

Best for: serious club and district cricket. The last stop before English willow, and for many players the sensible one.

products.name: KIS Game Changer — English Willow
products.description:
Grade A++ English willow, pressed in Kashmir. Straight grains, light pickup for its mass, and the ping a leather-ball season asks for.

English willow is softer and more fibrous than Kashmir, which is what produces the rebound players mean by ping — and also why it needs knocking in and looking after. Straight grains through the blade are the visible sign of a cleft cut true.

Best for: a full competitive season on turf. Ask us about knocking-in and oiling when you collect it.

products.name: KIS Classic — English Willow
products.description:
The English willow Classic: Grade A++ cleft, traditional profile, hand-made and knocked in. KIS's flagship for players in serious competitive cricket.

Everything in the range points here. A Grade A++ English cleft, shaped to the traditional profile that has outlasted every trend, hand-made and knocked in so it is ready for a hard ball on the day you collect it.

Best for: representative and premier-division cricket. Hand-picked at Toplay — come and feel three before you choose one.
